title: Sea For Two Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sea For Two is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 11 Savannah StreetRomantic Seaside Guest Cottage Across from the BeachSea for Two is a charming one-bedroom guest cottage in the heart of Seaside, Florida—perfectly designed for a romantic couples’ escape. Located directly across from the beach on Savannah Street, this Seaside vacation rental offers an unbeatable location just steps from the Gulf of Mexico and only two blocks from the Seaside Amphitheater and Central Square, where more than 40 restaurants, shops, and cafés are all within easy walking distance.Private, Peaceful First-Floor Bedroom & PorchAccessed via a quiet footpath, the rear entrance provides a sense of privacy rarely found in such a central location. The first floor features a welcoming foyer, a queen bedroom, and a full bathroom with a walk-in shower. French doors open from the bedroom to the cottage’s standout feature: a private rear deck with Adirondack seating for two—ideal for morning coffee, coastal breezes, or unwinding with a glass of wine in the evening.Light-Filled Living Space with Town ViewsA spiral staircase leads to the second-floor living area, where natural light and classic Seaside charm define the open-concept design. The well-equipped kitchen includes an oven, four-burner electric cooktop, dishwasher, mini fridge, microwave, blender, and coffee maker, along with a breakfast bar that seats three. The comfortable living area opens to a Juliette balcony overlooking Scenic Highway 30A, offering charming town views and front-row seating for Seaside fireworks on the Fourth of July and New Year’s Eve.Ideal for a Couples’ Beach GetawayQuaint, romantic, and ideally located, Sea for Two is the perfect Seaside guest cottage for a long weekend or intimate beach escape. For guests needing additional space, the main three-bedroom home, Monday’s Child, may also be rented. Book Sea for Two today and enjoy Seaside at its most walkable, charming, and unforgettable.Additional bonuses include and outdoor shower, charcoal grill, and stackable washer and dryer. For those in need of additional space, the main 3-bedroom cottage, "Monday’s Child", is also available for rent.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESFeatures 504 square feet1-minute walk, 75 feet to beach access- directly across the street from beachPrivate Seaside residential beach at Savannah Pavilion; largest private residential beaches on 30AWasher & dryer; stackablePeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickle ball courts (ct. fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedParking policy: Only 1 parking pass is issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets STR23-002361
